d:
The political rivalry between Raja Bhaiya and Akhilesh Yadav is heating up again in Kunda. Raja Bhaiya's show of strength through the Dhirendra Shastri event has added a new dimension to the political battle. From their changing political equations to the controversy surrounding Bageshwar Dham, what could this mean for the upcoming UP elections? Will Raja Bhaiya retain his stronghold, or can Akhilesh Yadav challenge his dominance?
